technical.summary: Bullish structure with strong trend confirmation and overbought oscillators limiting upside probability; moderate swing entry with elevated risk of pullback.

fundamental.summary: RVTY shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 89 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No congressional activity; market fear (37/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and bearish AAII sentiment (43.7%) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (348.48) with imminent NFP event in 1 day creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset to elevated systemic risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + EMA 50/200 bullish cross + supertrend confirmation + price above major MAs create textbook bullish structure with trend-following entry setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (348.48), imminent NFP event, triple overbought oscillators (Stoch/Williams/StochRSI), zero fundamental support, weak smart money alignment, and price at 52-week highs create compounding systemic and technical risk that overwhelms bullish technicals.
